title: Audio bitstream 16-bit reader
summary: Recover VA 0x58eab0 as a member method reading a big-endian three-byte window, returning 16 shifted bits and advancing the bit cursor. Preserves masked x86 shift counts, wrapping offset addition and arithmetic byte advance. Direct callers at 0x58f518 and 0x58fa84 pass this in ECX and store the return at +0x6d38.
test_description: Compare return values and every object byte with the accepted original routine for all offsets 0..7, repeated reads, final three-byte windows, zero/ones/ramp/bit and random data, edge and random 32-bit offsets. Verify opaque fields and all input bytes are untouched. Invalid offsets are tested for a single call only, without dereferencing the resulting pointer.
known_limits: Opaque object prefix and surrounding decoder behavior are not recovered.
Requires three readable input bytes; original has no bounds or refill handling. Faulting or self-aliasing input/object cases are not exercised.
Original ABI and pointer wrapping are i386; native 64-bit pointers support porting but do not reproduce 32-bit address-space wrap.
Behavioral recovery only; no matching-byte claim.
